summary_md: **Rehan Sheikh ([@rehan_shei](https://x.com/rehan_shei/status/2116062680121540611))** reports that Opus 5.5 can now author pixel-art effects in a write–render–inspect–fix loop, and open-sources **pixelfx**, 232 code-only effects made that way plus the Claude Code skill behind them ([patch-gg/pixelfx](https://github.com/patch-gg/pixelfx)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - patch-gg/pixelfx: 232 pixel art effects, every one a small piece of code. Plus a Claude Code skill to make your own.

relevance: A concrete self-verifying visual loop (render, look at frames, repair) packaged as an agent skill for procedural media.

media.description: Demo reel of generated pixel-art effects (not downloaded; referenced only).
